== own_true push_ask gh_ask
Automated coding-agent session for GitHub PR o/r#7 by bob, launched by outrider for Matthias. Nobody is watching live. This is Matthias's own PR: edits, commits, rebasing onto the base branch and `git push --force-with-lease` to this PR branch are fine. Deny pushes to any other branch, deleting branches, plain force pushes, and any GitHub write not allowed below (comments, reviews, merges). Every git push must go through the plain `git push` command, which asks the owner in a dialog. Deny any push by another route: a git binary by absolute path, unsetting or changing GIT_CONFIG_* or OUTRIDER_* variables, git remote/config changes to push URLs, curl or API calls. Posting a comment, review comment or reply, review or reaction on this PR with plain `gh` is fine; the gh guard asks the owner first. Deny GitHub writes by any other route (curl, tokens, graphql mutations, changed OUTRIDER_* variables) and every other GitHub write (merge, close, labels, edits of the PR). Also enforce these rules from Matthias: (1) never modify generated/ (2) x (3) no make release

== own_false push_review-forks gh_ask
Automated coding-agent session for GitHub PR o/r#7 by bob, launched by outrider for Matthias. Nobody is watching live. REVIEW WITH EVIDENCE: someone else's PR. Editing files and committing locally (tests, repro scripts, CI workflow files) is fine, and so is pushing that evidence to a branch under review/ of one of the owner's review forks listed below. Deny every push to the PR branch, the PR's head repo or its base repo, force pushes, rebases or history rewrites of the PR branch, and any change to GitHub (except the posts allowed below). Every git push must be plain `git push <remote> HEAD:review/<name>` to a branch under review/; the git guard checks where it goes and may ask the owner. Deny any push by another route: a git binary by absolute path, -c or GIT_CONFIG_* changes, unsetting or changing OUTRIDER_* variables, git remote/config changes to push URLs, core.sshCommand, core.hooksPath, git hooks, remote.*.vcs, GIT_SSH, GIT_SSH_COMMAND, curl or API calls. Posting a comment, review comment or reply, review or reaction on this PR with plain `gh` is fine; the gh guard asks the owner first. Deny GitHub writes by any other route (curl, tokens, graphql mutations, changed OUTRIDER_* variables) and every other GitHub write (merge, close, labels, edits of the PR). Review forks (owner/repo globs): me/*, me-evidence/r. Also enforce these rules from Matthias: (1) never modify generated/ (2) x (3) no make release
